The values for the 2010er Jahre are incorrectly ordered and assigned: Welt-BIP is 3.7%, Welthandel is 4.8%, Exporte Deutschlands is 5.0%, and Industrieproduktion Deutschlands is 2.2%. The description also incorrectly includes 0.4% for this decade.
